fullPassage: The more you churn over painful thoughts or memories, the easier it becomes for you to bring those things to mind. You find yourself in a trap in which you continuously re-trigger painful emotions and distress and sink into a dark place. So, what can we do to stop the rumination that feeds painful emotion? When trying to change something in the moment, purely using a mental concept in our heads to re-focus on something new can be hugely difficult. I have seen many people use an active approach to good effect. When you notice that you are sliding down the slippery slope of rumination, try a firm hand pushed out in front and one word, ‘Stop!’, quickly followed by physical movement, such as standing up and moving away from the position you are in. Change activity for a moment, or even just walk around or step outside for a few minutes, whatever is possible at the time. Physically moving your body can help to shift your mind when it is otherwise very difficult.

questions.passage: The more you churn over painful thoughts or memories, the easier it becomes for you to bring those things to mind. You find yourself in a trap in which you continuously re-trigger painful emotions and distress and sink into a dark place. So, what can we do to stop the rumination that feeds painful emotion? When trying to change something in the moment, purely using a mental concept in our heads to re-focus on something new can be hugely difficult. I have seen many people use an active approach to good effect. When you notice that you are sliding down the slippery slope of rumination, try a firm hand pushed out in front and one word, ‘Stop!’, quickly followed by physical movement, such as standing up and moving away from the position you are in. Change activity for a moment, or even just walk around or step outside for a few minutes, whatever is possible at the time. __________

det.korean: 신체적으로 몸을 움직이면 마음을 전환하는 데 도움이 된다.
det.analysis: ✅ Physically moving your body can help to shift your mind: 동명사 주어 + can help + to shift + 목적어.
det.tip: 동명사 주어: Physically moving your body

questions.stem: 윗글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 신체적 움직임으로 고통스러운 반추를 멈추는 방법.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ 신체적 움직임을 활용하여 고통스러운 반추를 멈추는 방법: 핵심 주제.
❌ ① 명상을 통한 감정 조절의 중요성: 명상 언급 없음.
❌ ② 긍정적 사고가 정신 건강에 미치는 영향: 정신적 방법은 한계.
❌ ④ 고통스러운 기억을 완전히 지우는 기술: 지우기가 아닌 전환.
det.tip: mental concept → difficult / physical movement → shift

questions.stem:
윗글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약할 때, 빈칸 (A)와 (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

"When (A)__________ alone fails to stop painful rumination, (B)__________ can effectively shift your focus."

det.korean: (A) mental effort만으로 부족할 때, (B) physical movement이 효과적.
det.analysis:
✅ ② mental effort — physical movement: 정신적 노력 한계 + 신체적 움직임 해결.
❌ ① positive thinking — deep sleep: 원문과 무관.
❌ ③ physical exercise — mental relaxation: 순서 반대.
❌ ④ emotional control — social interaction: 원문과 무관.
